title: Localqw6 Script Nuke By omer
script:
-- Sürüklenebilir GUI Oluşturma
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MODS_NUKE_GUI_V1"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 350) -- GUI boyutunu küçülttük
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -175) -- Orta konum
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40) -- Başlık boyutunu büyüttük
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
title.Text = "MODS NUKE GUI V1"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.TextSize = 20
title.Parent = frame

-- Buton Oluşturma Fonksiyonu
local function createButton(text, posY, callback)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40) -- Buton boyutlarını koruduk ama GUI'yi küçülttük
	button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, posY)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
	button.Text = text
	button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	button.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	button.TextSize = 18
	button.Parent = frame
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- 1 - MESSAGE JUMPSCARE
createButton("MESSAGE JUMPSCARE", 50, function()
	local emoji = "HACKED BY OMER 🎩"
	local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
	local metin = ""
	for i = 1, 80 do
		metin = metin .. string.rep(emoji, 100) .. "\n"
	end
	metin = metin .. "\n" .. string.rep(" ", 50) .. "MODS HACKED GAME LOLLLL"
	msg.Text = metin
	wait(5)
	msg:Destroy()
end)

-- 2 - MESSAGE JUMPSCARE 2
createButton("MESSAGE JUMPSCARE 2", 110, function()
	local emoji = "❤️"
	local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
	local metin = ""
	for i = 1, 80 do
		metin = metin .. string.rep(emoji, 100) .. "\n"
	end
	metin = metin .. "\nMODS HACKED GAME LOLLLL"
	msg.Text = metin
	wait(5)
	msg:Destroy()
end)

-- 3 - MEGA SONG
createButton("MEGA SONG", 170, function()
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://77227669080312"
	sound.Volume = 10e10
	sound.Looped = true
	sound:Play()
end)

-- 4 - SKYBOX SPAM
createButton("SKYBOX SPAM", 230, function()
	local ids = {
		"107021325188504",
		"116011811086034",
		"97746404812078"
	}
	while true do
		for _, id in pairs(ids) do
			local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
			sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			game.Lighting:ClearAllChildren()
			sky.Parent = game.Lighting
			wait(0.1)
		end
	end
end)

-- 5 - HINT SPAM
createButton("HINT SPAM", 290, function()
	local emoji = "❤️"
	local hint = Instance.new("Hint", workspace)
	local metin = ""
	for i = 1, 80 do
		metin = metin .. string.rep(emoji, 100) .. "\n"
	end
	metin = metin .. "\n" .. string.rep(" ", 50) .. "MODS HACKED GAME LOLLLL"
	hint.Text = metin
	wait(5)
	hint:Destroy()
end)

-- 6 - FIRE NUKER
createButton("FIRE NUKER", 350, function()
	for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr.Character then
			for _, part in pairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
					fire.Size = 100
					fire.Heat = 25
					fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
					fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)

					local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke", part)
					smoke.Color = Color3.new(1, 0.6, 1)
					smoke.Opacity = 1
					smoke.Size = 20
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- 7 - YER TABAKASI NUKE
createButton("YER TABAKASI NUKE", 410, function()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Position.Y < 10 then
			obj.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			obj.Transparency = 0.2

			local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
			explosion.Position = obj.Position
			explosion.BlastRadius = 5
			explosion.BlastPressure = 0
			explosion.Parent = workspace

			local selBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
			selBox.Adornee = obj
			selBox.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
			selBox.LineThickness = 0.1
			selBox.Parent = obj
		end
	end
end)

-- 8 - PLAYER GLITCH
createButton("PLAYER GLITCH", 470, function()
	for _, plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr.Character then
			for _, part in pairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					part.Color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 1, 1)
					local sel = Instance.new("SelectionBox", part)
					sel.Adornee = part
					sel.Color3 = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 1, 1)
					sel.LineThickness = 0.1

					local rot = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", part)
					rot.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
					rot.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(100000, 100000, 100000)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
